Event: Whitney cameo at the Radio Tower
Gold / Silver: Whitney's gym availability is not conditioned on the Radio Card quiz.

HeartGold / SoulSilver: Whitney is staged at the Radio Tower quiz; after the player wins the quiz her object is moved/hidden, narratively sending her back toward the Gym.
Integration decision: Use a first-contact location state. If the player visits the Radio Tower first, play the HGSS Whitney cameo; if the player challenges the Gym first, preserve GSC freedom and convert/suppress the cameo so Whitney is never duplicated. Never require the quiz to enter the Gym.

Gold / Silver: After losing, Whitney cries and initially withholds the Plain Badge until another trainer explains her behavior and the crying state clears.
Crystal: Same core crying/badge sequence.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Preserves the delayed badge flow with explicit scene/state variables and helper-NPC movement.
Integration decision: Keep the GSC sequence intact and use HGSS state handling/choreography to make the transition robust.

HeartGold / SoulSilver: Suicune uses a much longer chase with dedicated appearances extending through Johto and Kanto, eventually leading to a fixed encounter.
Integration decision: Never collapse these into one boolean. Keep source-specific progression facts and a shared caught state. Default integrated narrative can run Crystal/HGSS waypoints while an optional legacy roaming state remains representable.
Evidence: pokegold/pokecrystal Burned Tower scripts; pokeheartgold D18R0102, T06, R42, R14, R25 scripts

Evidence: project integration design grounded in distinct Crystal/HGSS scripts
